scope: Frontend ringkasan hasil belajar pengajar dan regresi seluruh prototype lokal

checks.name: Public, student, teacher and admin routes at 1280px
Public, student, teacher and admin routes at 390px
Registration, free practice, reload, checkout, payment and upgrade
Tryout autosave, resume, doubt flag, review and one-attempt restriction
Actual PDF download and admin CSV export with read-only payment details
Admin editing persists and preserves data history
Drilling resumes at the next unanswered question and historical review adds no attempt
Account recovery, profile edits and password change
Admin creates question, material, student and scheduled tryout from the bank
Admin subtest catalog, filters, previews and contextual forms
Admin pagination survives editing, tab changes and filters in other subtests
Admin mobile catalog and complete question preview fit the screen
Mobile menu, notifications, skip link and automatic expiry refresh
Teacher scoped catalog, content creation, immediate student access and forbidden subtest
Admin assigns teacher multiple subtests, revokes access and saves staff profile
Shared tryout collaboration by two teachers, read-only subtests and admin release
Mentor contact CRUD, assignment history and active student WhatsApp access
Video upload persists across reload, supports playback, and rejects invalid files
Profile dropdown routes payments and password; notification dropdown remains accessible
Teacher learning summaries, package filters, read-only preview and mobile layout
No unhandled browser errors

limitations: Data lokal di browser, belum tersambung API PHP/PostgreSQL.
Pembatasan router dan JavaScript bukan pengujian otorisasi server.
Ringkasan agregat, tanpa nilai/profil siswa individu.
